<!-- pr-reviewer: a4a05c880bc4912e8e78d781bc9966a4be90bc2a -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge** - the program-order change matches #167, old projects keep their posted order on load, and the touched suites pass.

**What looks good**
- `CreateOperation` now appends: `append_position` pins each sibling of the setup at its current index and gives the new op the next index. The sibling pins come from the same `operation_order` sort the post uses, so existing program order is unchanged. This matches #167's "done means".
- Undo works: `CreateOperation::invert` removes the op and restores the siblings' prior `OperationMeta`; `operation_metadata::creating_after_legacy_unordered_ops_keeps_their_name_order` checks that undo restores the unpinned position.
- Old projects: `operation_metadata::version_49_operations_keep_legacy_name_order` loads a v49 file with no stored positions and asserts the name order is kept. Load does not write positions, so nothing reorders silently.
- Positions round-trip: `project/wire.rs:82-83` writes `order`, `project/apply.rs:667-670` reads it back.
- Stale digest (#109): the rest digest hashes predecessors (names, kinds, paths, atoms) in `operation_order` sequence (`rest/ahead.rs`). The pins keep that sequence identical, and a new op lands last, so no existing op's predecessor set changes. Nothing reorders, so nothing goes stale.
- The PR changes an existing expectation on purpose: `remachining::program_order_is_the_creation_order_not_the_name_order` replaces the old "name order" wart test, and `RECOMMENDED.md` records the decision.
- No `unwrap()`, `expect()` or `panic!` in the added non-test code. Changelog line and `Fixes #167` are present.

**Local results (trial merge with current `origin/main`)**

Trial merge: `RECOMMENDED.md` conflicted (append-only ledger); resolved locally keeping both sides, committed as `trial merge (local review only)`, never pushed.

| Gate | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --lib` | 78 passed, 0 failed |
| `operation_metadata` | 5 passed, 0 failed |
| `setup_sheet` | 7 passed, 0 failed |
| `remachining` | 6 passed, 0 failed |
| `setups` | 11 passed, 0 failed |
| `project_roundtrip` | 68 passed, 0 failed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --lib --test operation_metadata --test setup_sheet --test remachining --test setups --test project_roundtrip -- -D warnings` | clean |

`cargo test -p camcraft-app --no-run` (all targets) fails on the merged tree with an error that is not from this PR:
```
error[E0063]: missing field `coolant` in initializer of `camcraft_app::schema::Operation`
  --> crates\app\tests\drilling_cross_holder.rs:47:5
```
`origin/main` has the same error. The `coolant` field was added to `schema.rs` by `62ff272` (per-operation coolant) and `drilling_cross_holder.rs` was not updated. This PR does not touch that file. The all-targets build needs that one-line fix on main; the targets above were built and run without it.

**Requested before merge**
- None from this PR.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- Nothing pins "appending an op leaves existing ops' status Ok" directly. The reasoning above says it holds; a one-line assert after a `GenerateOperation` in `remachining.rs` would make it a test.
- Maintainer: the `drilling_cross_holder.rs` break on `origin/main` needs its own fix (add `coolant` to that struct literal).

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
